results.title: Ugreen launches compact 20,000mAh power bank with 55W fast charging, display, and built-in cable
results.description: A new 20,000mAh power bank with a compact design is now available to buy in Europe. Capable of charging three devices at the same time, the new Ugreen model sports a smart battery health monitoring display and an integrated USB-C cable.
